# Evgenii Elovskii

> Independent iOS developer. One shipped app: Meteosense, a biometeorology app that scores how
> hard today's environment is pushing on a person and learns their individual sensitivity.

## Projects

- [Meteosense](https://elovskii.github.io/meteosense_app/): free iOS app that reads barometric
  pressure, temperature, humidity, wind, geomagnetic storms, solar flares and the Moon phase into
  one daily environmental load score. Full details in
  [its llms.txt](https://elovskii.github.io/meteosense_app/llms.txt).
